vb_textbox.text: The hats are important, you need to find the hat type (flat or pointy) that pays more and keep picking it, you should yield between 6-10 points on average. The type will change over time, if you find a particular type yielding 0-2 points then choose the opposite one for your next few tries, it would probably only yield 3-5 points but choose it anyway for a few times. After a few times go back to the hat type you were finding success with and it should be back to yielding 6-10 per game, you should be able to stay on that hat type for most of the game. Ignore colors, size of the gnome or anything else, they will only distract you
